title: TALK, LISTEN, CONNECT: HOW HUMANS AND AI EVALUATE EMPATHY IN RESPONSES TO EMOTIONALLY CHARGED NARRATIVES
reasoning: The paper quantitatively evaluates the influence of 'moral values' (specifically using the 'Sim_Moral' variable) on the alignment of empathy between humans and AI, and it explores the ethical design of emotionally intelligent systems and the potential harms of misaligned empathetic AI.
